steps: Be a registered voter in Monroe County, NY, able to read, write, and speak English.
Register on the county's MyPollWorker system ('Register as new user').
Complete the annual training ($25 per training) and pass the inspector exam.
Serve the Election Day 17-hour shift (bilingual/site-chair roles where assigned).
timing: Election Day, November 3, 2026; annual training in advance.
